* REQ: LANG-1541 LANG-1542 LANG-1543 LANG-1544
REPORT z_greeter.
" Inline comment
DATA lv_name TYPE string VALUE 'world'.
DATA lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.
CLASS lcl_greeter DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS greet IMPORTING iv_times TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS lcl_greeter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD greet.
    rv_text = |Hello, { lv_name }! { iv_times }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
START-OF-SELECTION.
  LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(lv_item).
    IF lv_item > 0 AND sy-subrc = 0.
      WRITE: / 'It''s', lv_item.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
